english_titles: 7 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour I
label: 7 / Crossroads at the Witching Hour I

lines.japanese:
「志貴さん、お楽しみのところ申し訳ありませんが、朝ごはんはどうなさいますか？
　そろそろ時間ですから、支度をしようと思いますけど」
「そっか、忘れてた。
……けどあんまり食欲はないんだ。
喉は乾いているんだけど、なんかお腹がいっぱいでさ」
「あ、ダメですよ志貴さんっ。
昨日もお倒れになったんですから、朝ごはんを摂らないとまたお体を悪くしますっ。
　ここは多少食欲がなくても、キチンと食事をなさっていただきますからね」
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, I’m sorry to interrupt while you’re enjoying yourself, but what would you like for breakfast? It’s nearly time, so I thought I should start preparing it.”
“Oh, right. I forgot. But I don’t have much of an appetite; I’m thirsty, yet somehow I feel full.”
“Oh, that won’t do, Shiki. You collapsed yesterday, so if you skip breakfast, you’ll only make yourself ill again.
Even if you don’t feel hungry, I’m going to see that you eat a proper meal.”

lines.japanese:
「……姉さん。
志貴さまは朝からご気分が優れないようでしたから、あまり無理を言うのもどうかと思います」
「もう、翡翠ちゃんは志貴さんに甘いんですから――――って、あれ？」
「志貴さん、今朝もご気分が優れないんですか？」
　じっ、と琥珀さんが見つめてくる。
　それに釣られてなのか、翡翠と秋葉もまじまじと見つめてきた。
　……なんていうか、あんまりその場しのぎの誤魔化しが通じる雰囲気じゃない。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
“Sister. Master Shiki has seemed unwell since this morning, so I don’t think we should force him.”
“Honestly, Hisui, you’re far too soft on Shiki—wait, what?”
“Shiki, are you feeling ill again this morning?”
Kohaku fixes me with an unwavering stare.
As if drawn in by her, Hisui and Akiha begin studying me just as intently.
Somehow, this does not feel like an atmosphere where a flimsy excuse will survive.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… Nee-san.
If Shiki-sama does not feel well, I do not think you should force him."
"Hisui-chan, you are too indulgent when it comes to Shiki-san----huh?"
"Shiki-san, you're not feeling well again this morning?"
Kohaku-san stares at me.
As if on cue, Hisui and Akiha add their serious stares on me as well.
…… I guess I really can't go on fooling myself.

lines.japanese:
「……あの、志貴さま？
　志貴さまの体調不良は、生活環境が変わったからだと思います。
　ですからその、お屋敷の生活が合わないようでしたら、しばらく有間の家に戻って養生なされてはどうでしょう……？」
「………………」
　翡翠の意見は、純粋に俺の体を心配しての事だった。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki? I think Master Shiki’s health may have suffered because his living situation changed so suddenly.
If life at the mansion doesn’t agree with you, perhaps you should return to the Arima family for a while and recuperate…?”
“…”
Hisui’s suggestion comes from nothing but genuine concern for me.

The promise from eight years ago has vanished as well; rather than force myself to stay, perhaps I should spend a few days with the Arimas and give my body a chance to recover.

----And then.
For a moment, I see a terrible image.

lines.japanese:
「……？
　テレビの映像かな」
　食堂の奥にでーん、と鎮座する大型テレビを眺める。
　うちの学校はその日の朝のニュースを録画しておいて、昼休みに食堂で流すという紙一重のサービスを実施している。
　今日も今日とて数時間遅れのニュースを映し出しているテレビをぼんやりと眺める。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
“What was that? Something on television?”
I look toward the enormous television enthroned at the back of the cafeteria.
Our school records the morning news and replays it during lunch—a service of distinctly questionable value.
Today, as ever, I gaze blankly at news already several hours old.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:

Is it the television screen?"
I gape at the large television mounted on the wall at the end of the cafeteria.
At my school, they record the morning news and replay it at lunch.
I just stare dumbfounded at the news broadcast that is several hours late.

　そのニュースを見て、愕然とした。
　テレビに映し出されているのは、昨日、夢で見た少女の顔だった。
　ニュースキャスターが喋っている。
　画面には大きく、吸血鬼殺人・新しい犠牲者、なんていう血文字のテロップ。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
“—No.”
The broadcast leaves me frozen.
The face on the screen belongs to the girl from last night’s dream.
The screen bears a huge blood-red caption.
VAMPIRE MURDER—ANOTHER VICTIM.

……少女は、とりあえず命を取り留めたらしい。
　体の血液を搾取された少女は病院で治療を受けているという。
　意識は不明。
回復の見込みも不明。
　……誰が少女を襲い、その血を奪ったのかも不明。
　画面に映し出された少女の写真は、間違いなく昨夜の少女だ。
―――なら、不明ではない事が一つだけある。
　　　彼女を襲った犯人は、紛れもなく――――
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
Apparently the girl survived, for now.
The report says she is in the hospital after having the blood drained from her body.
Whether she is conscious is unknown. Her prospects for recovery are unknown.
Who attacked her and stole her blood is also unknown.
But the photograph on the screen is unmistakably the girl from last night.
―――Then there is one thing that isn’t unknown.
The person who attacked her was beyond any doubt—

　気が、遠くなったような。
「なん………で？」
　アレは夢だ。

　なのに実際夢と同じ人間が、同じように、血を吸われてしまっている。

　弓塚は俺がこの手で殺した。
　吸血鬼事件なんていうものは、もう二度と起こらないはずじゃないのか。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
“…”
I feel consciousness slipping away.
“Why?”
That was a dream. There can be no doubt that it was a dream.
Yet the same person has suffered the same fate in reality, her blood taken exactly as I saw it.
“But there aren’t any vampires left.”
I killed Yumizuka with my own hands.
Wasn’t that supposed to mean the vampire murders could never happen again?

lines.mirrorMoon:

I start to feel faint.
"How……… come?"
That was a dream.
It had to be a dream.
But in reality, the same person in my dream, had her blood sucked out the same way in my dream.
"That vampire should be gone already."
I killed Yumizuka with my own hands.
Those killings, they shouldn't be happening anymore.

lines.label: s419

lines.maoEnglish:
I told you so, Shiki.
Holding back never did any good.
lines.mao_english:

何をとぼけてやがる。
　オマエは俺以上の殺人鬼じゃないか。

You’re an even worse killer than I am.

lines.mirrorMoon:

　吐き気を堪えて席を立つ。
　教室には戻れない。
　そのまま街へと走り出していた。

lines.maoEnglish:
“Urgh―――”
Fighting the urge to vomit, I stagger to my feet.
I can’t go back to the classroom.
Before I know it, I’m running out into the city.

　まわりには警察官が何人かいて、路地裏へは立ち入り禁止のテープがはられていた。
「―――同じだ」

―――いや、アレは夢じゃない。
　もう、夢だって誤魔化すことなんてできない。

Several police officers are standing nearby, and tape seals off the alley.
“—It’s the same.”
I passed through this place in the dream.
―――No—that wasn’t a dream.
I can’t hide behind that excuse any longer.

このまま、屋敷に戻るしかなかった。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
“…”
Staying here will only draw suspicion from the police.
It’s too late to return to school. I have no choice but to go back to the mansion.

まだ午後二時になったばかりのためか、ロビーには誰も待ってはいなかった。
「………………」
　都合がいいといえば都合がいい。
今は誰にも会いたくない。
　ふと、窓ガラスに視線を移す。
　そこにいるのは青ざめた顔をした、別人のような遠野志貴だった。
　別人のような自分。
　別人のようなユメ。
　意識には表れない、
　記憶にだけ残る殺人の跡。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
Perhaps because it is only just after two in the afternoon, no one is waiting in the foyer.
“…”
That suits me. I don’t want to see anyone.
My eyes drift to the window.
Reflected in the glass is Shiki Tohno, pale-faced and looking like a stranger.
A self like someone else.
A dream belonging to someone else.
A murder absent from consciousness,
leaving its traces only in memory.

the traces of the killing that only remains in my memory.

くらりと。
　目の前が、闇に変わっていく。

The world sways.
Darkness spreads across my sight.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
Dizziness.
Before me, my vision goes black.

「違う――――！
　俺は親父と同じなんかじゃないっ……………！！！」
　必死に眩暈をこらえて、倒れそうになる体を立て直した。
「――――――親父だ」
　親父の部屋に行って、親父がどんな病状だったのか調べてみればいい。
　そうすれば俺は遠野槙久とは違う事がはっきりするし、もし同じなら――――何か、解決策のようなものが残っているかもしれない。

“No—! I’m nothing like my father…!”
I fight the vertigo and wrench my collapsing body upright.
“—Father.”
I can search his room and find out what illness he had.
Then I’ll know whether I’m different from Makihisa Tohno—and if I’m not, perhaps he left behind some kind of cure.

lines.maoEnglish:
Makihisa Tohno’s room is in the west wing of the first floor, beside Kohaku’s.
For once, cutting school has worked in my favor.
At this hour, Kohaku, Hisui, and Akiha are all gone.
I draw my knife and remove my glasses.
I’m about to cut the lock on the door when I put the glasses back on.
The door isn’t locked.

I try to cut the "line" of the door's lock and put my glasses back on.

親父の部屋は当時のままだ。
　並べられた書籍はその大部分が学術書で、これといって興味を引くものはない。
　今の自分がほしいものは親父の日記や手記だ。
　几帳面だった親父のことだから、まず間違いなくそういった類のものを遺しているハズ―――

「……くそ。
さすがに目の届く場所には見あたらないか」
　あるとしたら鍵のかかった所だろう。
　机の引き出しあたりを、とりあえず見てみよう。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
My father’s room is exactly as it was.
Most of the books lining the shelves are academic texts, nothing that interests me.
What I need is a diary or personal journal.
Knowing how meticulous he was, he must have left something of the kind—
“Damn. I suppose he wouldn’t leave it lying in plain sight.”
If anything exists, it will be somewhere locked.
I’ll start with the desk drawers.

lines.mirrorMoon:
My old man's room is just like it always was.
Nearly all of the rows of books are educational reports, and nothing catches my attention.
What I want right now is my old man's journal or notes.
The old man was extremely methodical.
There certainly has to be something like that lying around here somewhere---

"…… Of course, they're not just lying about where anyone can see them."
Maybe they're locked away somewhere.
I should probably look in these desk drawers first.

This is no time for scruples.
I remove my glasses and look for a line.
With the knife, I cut the line on the drawer’s lock.
Inside the desk are an old bundle of records tied with string and a book that looks like a journal.

Inside, there appears to be some old documents bundled together and what seems to be a journal.

lines.japanese:
まず古い記録書に目を通す。
「……これ、うちの家系図かな」
　間違いない。
　遠野マキヒサの後には遠野シキ、遠野アキハという名前がある。
　そのすぐ後ろに、ナナヤという単語があった。
「……親父のヤツ、十年前に養子をとってる。
……けど、それもすぐに病死してるのか」
　十年前っていえば、俺が小学一年生の頃だ。
　そんな大昔のことなら、覚えていないのも当然か。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
I examine the old records first.
“Could this be our family tree?”
There is no mistake.
After Makihisa Tohno come the names Shiki Tohno and Akiha Tohno.
Immediately behind them appears the word Nanaya.
“Father adopted a child ten years ago. But the child died of illness soon afterward.”
Ten years ago, I would have been in first grade.
If it happened that long ago, no wonder I don’t remember.

lines.mirrorMoon:
First, I look at the old documents.
"…… This is, my family tree?"
Definitely.
Right after Tohno MAKIHISA is written Tohno SHIKI and Tohno AKIHA.
And right after that, the word "Nanaya" is written there.
"Eh…… my old man, he adopted a son ten years ago?
…… Ah, but he passed away shortly thereafter."
Ten years ago, that would mean I was just in elementary school.
That long ago, it's only natural that I wouldn't remember.

lines.japanese:
「……しかし、うちの当主ってのは本当に短命なんだな。
親父も五十前に病死してるし、その前は三十歳の時に事故死、か。
……その前は十八歳で自殺している―――」
――――いや、待て。
　いくらなんでも、これは、おかしい。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
“The heads of this family really do die young. Father died of illness before he reached fifty, and the head before him died in an accident at thirty. The one before that committed suicide at eighteen―――”
――――No, wait.
This is too strange.
lines.mao_english:
“The heads of this family really do die young. Father died of illness before he reached fifty, and the head before him died in an accident at thirty. The one before that committed suicide at eighteen―――”
――――No, wait.
This is too strange.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Let's see…… the heads of the household have had pretty short lifespans.
My old man died before he was fifty, and before that, before thirty in an accident… before that, eighteen years of age, with suicide---"
----No, wait a second.
No matter how you look at it, this is strange.

evidence.japanese:
「ふうん……うちの当主ってわりと短命なんだな。
　親父も五十前に病死してるし、その前は三十歳の時に事故死、か。
……その前は十八歳で、自殺してる―――」
――――いや、待て。
　いくらなんでも、これは、おかしい。
　しっかりと家系図に目を通すと、遠野家の人間はみな異状な死に方をしていた。
　発狂死。
事故死。
他殺。
行方不明。
死産。
　……誰一人として、寿命で静かに他界したものがいない。
evidence.japaneseHighlight: その前は三十歳の時に事故死
evidence.label: s395
evidence.mirrorMoon:
"But, the heads of the household have had pretty short lifespans.
My old man died before he was fifty, and before that, before thirty in an accident…… Wow, before that, eighteen years of age, suicide…!?"

No matter how you look at it, this is strange.
Looking through the family tree, all members of the Tohno household have died strangely.
Madness.
Accidents.
Murder.
Disappearances.
Stillbirth.
…… Not one of them lived a long life or even died peacefully.

lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
When I study the family tree more closely, I find that every member of the Tohno family met an unnatural end.
Death by madness. Accident. Murder. Disappearance. Stillbirth.
Not one of them reached the end of a natural life and died in peace.
“What…”
The record reads like the history of a cursed family.
Madness accounts for most of the deaths. The greater part of the Tohno line ended by taking their own lives.

lines.japanese:
「おかしい―――おかしいぞ、これ」
　だが、一体なにがおかしいのかが解らない。
「……あとは……親父の手記か」
　わりと新しい装丁をした手記を手にとる。
――――どくん。
　鼓動が響く。
　この中身を見てはいけないと、心のどこかで悟っている。
　だが、今さら戻れない。
　ごくりと唾を飲みこんで、親父の手記を開いた。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
“This is wrong—something is wrong here.”
Yet I can’t say what is wrong.
“That leaves Father’s journal.”
I pick up the comparatively new-looking volume.
――――Thump.
My heartbeat reverberates through me.
Somewhere inside, I know I must not read what is written here.
But I’ve come too far to turn back.
I swallow and open my father’s journal.

lines.mirrorMoon:

"…… Next is…… my old man's journal."

----Thump, Thump.

But I can't turn back now.
Swallowing hard, I open my old man's journal.

lines.japanese:
―――遠野の血筋には魔が宿る。
　書き出し文は、そういった類のものだった。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
―――Something demonic dwells in the Tohno bloodline.
That is how it begins.
lines.mao_english:
―――Something demonic dwells in the Tohno bloodline.
That is how it begins.
lines.mirrorMoon:
------There is a demon lurking inside the Tohno bloodline.
The opening statement is in those lines.
lines.mirror_moon:
------There is a demon lurking inside the Tohno bloodline.
The opening statement is in those lines.

lines.japanese:
それは、比喩ではない。
　遠野の祖先は本当に『人間でないモノ』との混血で、子孫にあたる自分たちにも、その『人間でないモノ』の血が混ざっている、という事だった。
　血は。
　濃い者と薄い者に分かれる。
　血が薄い者なら普通の人間として問題なく暮らしていけるが、濃い者であるのなら、人間として生きていく事はできない。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
It is no metaphor.
The Tohno ancestors truly mingled their blood with things that were not human, and that inhuman blood still runs in us, their descendants.
That blood manifests in some more strongly than in others.
Those in whom it runs thin can live without difficulty as ordinary humans.
Those in whom it runs thick cannot live as human beings.
lines.mao_english:

That blood manifests in some more strongly than in others.
Those in whom it runs thin can live without difficulty as ordinary humans.
Those in whom it runs thick cannot live as human beings.
lines.mirrorMoon:
And that isn't just a simple metaphor.
The ancestors of the Tohno were a mixed breed of "something nonhuman" and human.
We, being their descendants, also have this element of "something nonhuman" in our blood.
In regards to our blood…
There are those with strong and those with weak nonhuman blood.
Those with weak nonhuman blood can live their lives as ordinary people, but those with strong nonhuman blood can never live a normal life.

lines.japanese:
遠野の血が濃い者は特別な力を身体に宿して生まれてくる。
　それは死ににくい体であったり、
　手を使わず物を動かす力であったり、
　他人から体液を搾取する牙であったりした。
　この血。
　この血が濃く現れだした遠野の人間は、段々と理性を失っていく。
　そうして理性を失ってしまった遠野の人間はその大部分が人を食う悪鬼に成り果てる。
　故に、遠野の当主は、そうなってしまった同族を処罰する責任があるという。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
Those born with a strong inheritance of Tohno blood bear special powers within their bodies.
Flesh that is difficult to kill,
The ability to move objects without touching them,
Or fangs that drain bodily fluids from others.
That blood.
When it begins to manifest strongly in a Tohno, reason slowly erodes.
Most who lose it altogether become man-eating demons.
The head of the Tohno family is therefore charged with punishing any member of the clan who falls that far.

lines.mirrorMoon:
Those with strong Tohno blood are born with special powers.
It could be a body that is resistant to death,
it could be an ability to move things without touching them,
or it could be fangs used to take bodily fluids from other people.

This blood.
When this blood becomes too strong, the members of the Tohno family start to gradually lose their sanity.
The majority of those become demons that feed on human flesh.
So, the head of the Tohno household carries the responsibility of punishing those who have turned into such a monster.

「――――――――」
　……どうかしてる。
　親父は、なにを。
夢物語みたいなことを、こんなに真面目に書き記しているんだろうか。
――――手記は、いつのまにか親父の語りに移り変わっていた。
　日付はおよそ九年前。
　手記には乱れた文字が続いている。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
“…”
This is insane.
What could Father have been thinking? Why record such fairy-tale nonsense with such deadly seriousness?
――――Without my noticing, the journal has shifted into my father’s own voice.
The entry is dated roughly nine years ago.
The handwriting that follows is erratic.

Writing so seriously about something that's more like a fairy tale.
-----The journal turns more into the old man's rant.

lines.japanese:
ついに、自分の血の昂ぶりが押さえられなくなってきた。
　共感者の一族の孤児を手に入れ、自らの意志を強化したところで、それもいずれ効かなくなるだろう。
　私が私でいられる時間は、あとわずかなものかもしれない。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
At last, the rising of my blood has grown impossible to contain.
I acquired an orphan of a resonator clan and used the child to reinforce my will, but in time even that will cease to suffice.
Little time may remain in which I can still be myself.
lines.mao_english:

Little time may remain in which I can still be myself.
lines.mirrorMoon:
I am no longer able to suppress my raging blood.
I was able to obtain an orphan from a family of Synchronizers, so this should help me strengthen my mind.
However, it really is only a matter of time before I go insane.

lines.japanese:
……恐ろしくなる。
　気がつけば、一日の半分がまったく記憶にない。
　私は、私の知らないところで、自身の反転している衝動をあの子供に押し付けてしまっている。
　このままでは。
　いずれ完全に理性をなくして、ただのケモノに成り果てるだろう。
　私が私としていられる時間はあとどれほど残っているのか。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
I am afraid.
When awareness returns, I find half the day entirely missing from my memory.
Without knowing it, I am forcing the impulses of my Inversion onto that child.
At this rate.
I will eventually lose all reason and become a mere beast.
How much longer can I remain myself?

lines.mirrorMoon:
…… It is terrifying.
When I come to, I find that I can't even remember half of the day.
During that time, I'm forcing my inversion impulse on that child.
If this keeps up,
it is only a matter of time before I completely lose my sanity and turn into a beast.
I don't even know how much time I have left to remain as myself.

lines.japanese:
いや、あの感応者の子供がいればあと数年は保つだろう。
　だがあの子供のほうは私の行為に耐えきれまい。
　おそらく、あの子供が壊れた後、私は自らの手で自分の命を絶たなければなるまい。
　……皮肉なものだ。
　自身を守るために多くの障害を排除してきた私は、結局は自身の手で命を絶たなければならないらしい。
　それとも、これは七夜の呪いなのか。
　戯れでヤツの息子を飼ってみたが、その程度ではヤツの怨念は断ち切れなかったという事か。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
No—with that resonator child, I may endure for several years yet.
But the child cannot withstand what I am doing. Once the child breaks, I will most likely have to end my life with my own hands.
How ironic.
After removing so many obstacles to preserve myself, I am apparently destined to die by my own hand.
Or is this the curse of Nanaya?
I kept his son as a pet on a whim, but perhaps even that was not enough to sever the father’s hatred.

lines.mirrorMoon:
No.
If that child is here, then I can probably last for a few more years.
But that child will not be able to bear that.
After that child breaks, I will have to take my own life.
…… It is incredibly ironic.
I eliminated so many things in order to preserve myself, but in the end, I will probably have to commit suicide.
Or maybe this is the curse of the Nanayas.
I end up adopting his son, but I guess I could not lift their grudge with such a thing.

He had simply become violent without knowing it.
Just like—Shiki Tohno now.

lines.maoEnglish:
“—Something’s wrong.”
But that isn’t what troubles me.
Father wrote the names SHIKI and Akiha phonetically, in an odd manner.
I check the family tree again; Akiha’s name is written normally, but SHIKI’s is given with the characters for ‘four seasons.’
“Four Seasons—that can be read Shiki, but――――”
Instinct warns me not to think any further, yet the torrent won’t stop.
“What does this word resonator mean? Does it refer to the adopted child?”
Somehow that feels wrong too.

"----That's strange."
But, that isn't what concerns me.
He writes SHIKI and AKIHA strangely.
Looking back to the family tree, I see that he writes "Akiha" using the Chinese characters for "Autumn Leaves", while "SHIKI" is written using the characters for "Four Seasons".
"The characters for 'Four Seasons' can certainly be pronounced as 'SHIKI', but the characters in my name are 'Intention' and 'Esteemed'."
I have a feeling that thinking too hard about that will be bad, but my train of thought does not stop.
"…… What are these 'Synchronizers'?
Maybe the adopted child?"
But, I feel that's wrong too.

SHIKI’s Inversion is severe. I therefore judge that he must be punished. Even as part of my duty as head of the Tohno family, it pains me to kill my own son.

　シキの能力は『不死』と『共融』である。

On a latent level I sense an older Origin in Akiha, but SHIKI’s blood is the more concentrated.

For a first exercise of his abilities, the result was undeniably impressive.

As long as that thing survives, I intend to put it to use.
If there are objections, I request a reply.

補足。
　七夜の血筋は、ある種殺人鬼を輩出する一族である。
　もしあの養子が生き残ってしまった場合、命を共有して繋がっているシキに悪影響を及ぼすだろう。
　折角理性を取り戻したシキが、七夜の養子に引きずられて『殺人鬼』になってしまう可能性も否定できない。
　そのような事態が起きないよう、養子は目の届く範囲で飼わなければならない。
だが遠野の屋敷に近づける事も許されない。

lines.maoEnglish:

The Nanaya bloodline produces a particular breed of killer.
Should the adoptee survive, he may exert a harmful influence on SHIKI, to whom he is joined through their shared life. We cannot dismiss the possibility that SHIKI, having finally regained his reason, will be dragged along by the Nanaya adoptee and become a ‘killer’ himself.
To prevent that outcome, the adopted child must be kept on a short leash and under observation. He must not, however, be allowed anywhere near the Tohno mansion.
Select a suitable branch family to manage him.

Akiha says this with her voice full of confidence.

「秋葉。

「はい。
十年前にお父様によって引き取られた養子です。

　兄さん、私たちにはシキというもう一人の遊び仲間がいた事を覚えていますか？」
「――――――いや。
思い出せない」
「でしょうね。
それはお父様が兄さんに暗示をかけたからです」

“—No. I can’t remember.”
“Of course not. Father placed a suggestion in your mind.”

「……シキは、遠野家の血に耐えられなかった人でした。
兄さんは覚えていないでしょうけど、八年前のあの日、兄さんはシキから私を守ってくれたんですよ。

“外れて”しまった一族の者を処分するのは遠野家の当主の義務ですから」
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
“SHIKI was unable to endure the Tohno blood. You won’t remember, but on that day eight years ago, you protected me from him. You put your own body between me and SHIKI after he became a blood-starved murderer.
He killed you, and Father disposed of him in turn. Punishing those members of the clan who stray beyond the bounds is the duty of the Tohno family head.”

lines.mirrorMoon:

lines.japanese:
「……？
　殺されたって言うけど、俺は生きてるじゃないか」
「―――はい。
兄さんは奇跡的に一命をとりとめました。
その後の事は覚えているでしょう？
　兄さんは病院に運ばれて、屋敷に帰ってきたその日に有間の家へ預けられた。
　その時にお父様は兄さんに暗示をかけたんでしょう。
兄さんはまだ傷も治りきっていなくて、心身ともに不安定な状態だった。
だから簡単に、本当に根深くお父様の暗示を信じてしまったんだわ」
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
“What? You say he killed me, but I’m alive.”
“—Yes. By some miracle, you survived. You remember what followed, don’t you? You were taken to the hospital, and on the very day you returned to the mansion, you were sent to the Arima family.
Father must have planted that suggestion in your mind then. Your wounds had not yet healed, and both your body and mind were terribly unstable. That made it easy for his suggestion to take root in you—deeply, completely.”

"---Yes.

You were taken to a hospital and the day you returned, you were adopted by the Arima family.
That is when Father hypnotized you.
You were not fully healed so your heart and mind was weak.
So you easily believed what Father told you."

「……誤解しないで兄さん。
　私は世間体のために貴方を兄さん、と呼んでいたんじゃないわ。
　覚えてないの？
　私、兄さんがシキに殺される前から貴方の事を兄さんと呼んでいた。
だから貴方が養子であろうと何であろうと関係ないんです。
　私は初めから兄さんが実の兄でない事は知っていました。

　だから―――兄さんがどんなに否定しようと、兄さんはもう遠野志貴なんです。
ですからずっと、貴方はこの屋敷にいてください」
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
“Don’t misunderstand me, Brother.
I never called you that for appearances’ sake.
Don’t you remember? I called you Brother even before SHIKI killed you. Whether you were adopted or anything else never mattered.
I knew from the beginning that you weren’t my brother by blood.
You accepted it.
So no matter how fiercely you deny it, you are already Shiki Tohno. Please stay in this mansion with me forever.”
lines.mao_english:

So please stay here in this mansion."

「……もう。

“Honestly. After everything I’ve said, you still don’t understand.

「人殺しって、それはどういう事ですか？」
「………………」
　ここまできた以上、隠しとおす事はできない。
　俺は今までの出来事――――昨夜の殺人の夢や自分に覚えのない血の跡の事、そして、秋葉に殺される夢を見た事。

“…”

I tell her everything that has happened—the dream of murder last night, the bloodstains I couldn’t remember leaving, and the dream in which Akiha killed me.

She makes me look stupid, worrying about all of this.

lines.japanese:
「ああ、おかしい。
いい？
　兄さんは決して吸血鬼なんかじゃないのよ。
兄さんは七夜という、あくまで人として優れた血を持つだけなんだから。
　それに七夜の方たちは殺人鬼なんかじゃないわ。
　……確かにお父様から見れば殺人鬼でしょうけど、七夜の方たちが殺人衝動を覚えるのは人間外のヒトにだけなんです。
　だから、兄さんが見ているのは只の夢にすぎない。
その夢だって、シキという殺人鬼から流れてしまった想念みたいなものだから、兄さん本人の嗜好じゃない」
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
“Oh, it is funny. Listen to me, Brother. You are not a vampire. The Nanaya blood is exceptional, but entirely human.
And the Nanayas are not killers.
Father might have seen them that way, certainly, but the Nanayas feel a murderous impulse only toward things that look human yet are not.
So what you saw was nothing more than a dream. Even that dream was only a residue of thought that leaked into you from the killer called SHIKI, not a reflection of your own desires.”

I feel as though I have met him before.
Did that happen in a dream too?
No, whether it did or not, if a killer is loose in this city, then he must be—

“What?”
Even Akiha, who had been hiding her laughter until now, turns grave.

「お父様の手記……？」
　はて、と不思議そうに首をかしげる秋葉。
「親父は俺とシキは繋がっていると言ってた。

“Father’s journal…?”
Akiha tilts her head in genuine puzzlement.
“Father wrote that SHIKI and I were connected. Then the dreams I’m seeing may be SHIKI’s.”
No, more likely, they are the murders SHIKI himself is committing.

lines.japanese:
「……確かにその可能性はあります。
お父様の死因も不審な点が多々ありましたし、屋敷の地下牢には誰かを匿っていた跡がありましたから」
「……ちょっと秋葉。
屋敷の地下牢って、この家ってそんな物騒なものがあるのか」
「あら、それは当然でしょう？
　遠野家の人間の多くは精神に異常をきたすんですもの。
外の世界に害を及ぼさないよう、そういった結界は用意してあります。
　まあ、用途はそれだけじゃありませんけど。
私も子供の頃、お父様の言いつけを破った時はよく閉じ込められましたし」
　なぜか楽しそうに、秋葉はこちらを流し見てくる。
　……なんか、背筋がぶるっときた。
lines.label: s419
lines.maoEnglish:
“That is possible. Father’s death was suspicious in several respects, and there were signs that someone had been hidden in the cells beneath the mansion.”
“Wait, Akiha. There are underground cells in this house?”
“Why, of course. Many members of the Tohno family suffer mental disturbances. We need such facilities to prevent them from harming the outside world.
Though that isn’t their only use. Father often locked me there when I disobeyed him as a child.”
For some reason, Akiha gives me a sidelong look of delight.
A chill runs down my back.

For some reason, Akiha sounds like she is having fun.
…… A chill runs down my spine.

“Then he does. That would not be our responsibility.”
Akiha says it while staring directly into my eyes.

「………ここには居ないみたいね」

　独り言が聞こえるぐらい、距離が近くなっているという事か。
　物陰から顔を出して、大通りを見た。
lines.label: s420
lines.maoEnglish:
I sensed someone and ducked out of sight.
Akiha approached, looking restlessly from side to side.
She seemed to be searching for something.
“It doesn’t seem to be here.”
I heard her murmur to herself.
If I could make out a whisper, she had come dangerously close.
I peered from my hiding place onto the avenue.

　頭が割れて死んでしまったか、と真剣に思ったほどだ。

Pain split my head.
Something inside it cracked.
――――I fell to the ground.
I had never known a headache like it.
For one brief instant, I truly believed my skull had burst and killed me.

　頭をふって立ち上がる。
　どのくらい倒れていたのか、さっきより夜の静けさが深い。
―――って、ちょっと待った。
「な、なんでこんな所にいるんだ、俺！？」
　いつのまにか大通りまでやってきている。
　屋敷の門で秋葉を見かけて、その後―――そう、秋葉を追いかけてきたんだっけ。
「……なにしてんだよ、俺は」
　自分で自分の行為に呆れてしまう。
lines.label: s420
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ah―――――it hurts”
I shook my head and forced myself up.
I couldn’t tell how long I had lain there, but the night had grown even deeper and stiller.
―――Wait a moment.
“W-why am I all the way out here?”
Somehow I had reached the main avenue.
I had seen Akiha at the mansion gate and then―――yes, I had followed her.
“What the hell am I doing?”
My own behavior left me appalled.

An odor I had never known before. One I had tasted again and again in my dreams.
“From that alley…?”
Dread seized me, and I ran toward it.

A stranger lay crumpled in the alley.
Blood ran from the person’s neck, but they were still breathing.
“…”
My vision flooded red.
This was no dream.
Perhaps because I had witnessed murder so many times, my thoughts remained perfectly calm.

　後は救急車が来る前に、誰にも見られないように屋敷に戻らなくてはいけない。

I ran to a public telephone and called the nearest hospital that handled emergencies.
I invented a name, gave them the exact location of the alley and the victim’s condition, then hung up.
Now I had to return to the mansion before the ambulance arrived, without letting anyone see me.

I had done nothing wrong, yet involvement felt dangerous, and I believed I had taken the best course available to me.
The person in the alley had still been breathing,
the blood loss hadn’t looked severe, so their life probably wasn’t in danger.

I asked Kohaku-san, but it doesn't seem like there was a new victim in the news today.
I guess last night's victim was saved, but while SHIKI is on the loose, there will be more victims.
"…… If only this body did what I told it to, I---"
I could stop SHIKI.
I lay my head back down on the pillow as I start to say that.
Maybe it's because I've been seeing those dreams, but I'm beginning to have violent thoughts like SHIKI.
"…… Whatever I do, I should heal up first."
I close my eyes.
evidence.mirrorMoonHighlight: Maybe it's because I've been seeing those dreams, but I'm beginning to have violent thoughts like SHIKI.

evidence.japanese:
琥珀さんに尋ねた所、今朝のニュースで新しい死者が出た、というものはなかったそうだ。
　それでもシキが野放しになっている以上、犠牲者はまた出てきてしまうだろう。
「……この体がもう少し思い通りになってくれれば、俺が―――」
　シキを止める、と言いかけて、枕に頭をうずめた。
　あんな夢を見続けた影響だろうか。
俺もシキに負けず劣らず物騒な思考をしている。
「……何をするにしても、とにかく体を治さないとダメだよな」
　目蓋を閉じる。

lines.japanese:
――――部屋に戻ろう。
　翡翠が語ったコトバが、頭の中で渦を巻いてしまっている。
　ただでさえ重い体は、目に見えない言霊の鎖でよけいギクシャクと稼動する。
「………………………っ」
　階段を上ろうとして、体が軋んだ。
　……足があがらない。
歩くことしか、できそうにない。
「……………………どうしたんだ、これ」
　……仕方がない。
台所に戻って、翡翠に肩を貸してもらって――――
lines.label: s421
lines.maoEnglish:
――――I should go back to my room.
Hisui’s words churned endlessly inside my head.
My body was heavy enough already; now invisible chains forged from those words made every movement stiff and awkward.
“…”
I tried to climb the stairs, and my body creaked in protest.
My legs wouldn’t rise. Walking on level ground was all I could manage.
“What’s wrong with me?”
There was no choice. I would return to the kitchen and ask Hisui to help me upstairs――――
lines.mao_english:

My legs wouldn’t rise. Walking on level ground was all I could manage.
“What’s wrong with me?”
There was no choice. I would return to the kitchen and ask Hisui to help me upstairs――――
lines.mirrorMoon:
----I should go back to my room.
Hisui's words echo inside my head.
My leaden body weakens more, weighed down by those chains.
"…………………………"
I try to go up the stairs and my body stops.
…… My legs can't go far up enough.
It looks like I can only walk.
"…………………… What is this?"
…… Oh well.
I should go back to the kitchen to ask Hisui to lend me her shoulder----

lines.japanese:
「あ――――――れ」
　台所に戻ろうとして、絨毯に倒れこんだ。
「―――――ちょっ、と」
　声もあげられない。
　ずるずると腕だけで這って、すぐに力尽きた。
lines.label: s421
lines.maoEnglish:
“What…?”
I turned toward the kitchen and collapsed onto the carpet.
“Wait―――just”
I couldn’t even raise my voice.
Dragging myself by my arms, I crawled a short distance before my strength deserted me.
lines.mao_english:

I couldn’t even raise my voice.
Dragging myself by my arms, I crawled a short distance before my strength deserted me.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"H------uh?"
I start to go back and collapse on the carpet.
"-----H, hey."
I can't even shout.
I exhaust myself crawling on my arms.
lines.mirror_moon:
"H------uh?"
I start to go back and collapse on the carpet.
"-----H, hey."
I can't even shout.
I exhaust myself crawling on my arms.

lines.japanese:
カツカツ、という足音が聞こえてくる。
　台所から翡翠がやってくる。
　……助かった。
ともかく、これで翡翠に肩を貸してもらえ―――
　カツカツ、カツカツ、カツ。
「……………………うそ」
　階段から這って進んだ事が裏目に出たのか。
　ちょうど俺は物陰に入ってしまって、翡翠は気がつかずに階段を上がっていってしまった。
lines.label: s421
lines.maoEnglish:
Sharp footsteps approached from the kitchen.
Hisui was coming.
Saved. Now she could help me up―――
Click, click, click, click, click.
“You’re kidding.”
Crawling away from the stairs had worked against me.
I had ended up behind an obstruction, and Hisui passed without noticing me, then climbed the stairs.

lines.mirrorMoon:
Clomp, clomp.
I hear footsteps.
Hisui comes from the kitchen.
…… I'm saved.
Now Hisui can help me out---
Clomp-clomp, clomp-clomp, clomp.
"…………………… No way."
Crawling away from the stairs backfired.
I have hidden myself in the shadows and Hisui goes up the stairs without even noticing me.

lines.japanese:
「……………………なんか、すごく間抜けじゃないのか、俺」
　ぼんやりと呟いた瞬間、ぞくり、と。
　近くに、自分以外の気配を感じた。
「―――――――――――！」
　倒れたまま視線を後に向ける。
　そこには。
　幽霊のような、人影が。
lines.label: s421
lines.maoEnglish:
“I look unbelievably stupid right now, don’t I?”
The moment I muttered it, a chill ran through me.
I sensed someone nearby.
“―――――――――――!”
Still sprawled on the floor, I craned my neck to look behind me.
There.
A human shape stood there, pale and insubstantial as a ghost.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"………………………… That was incredibly stupid of me."
As soon as I voice my thoughts, something catches my attention.
The feeling of something close to me.
"-----------!"
I look behind me as I'm lying on the ground.
Over there,
a ghost-like figure.

lines.japanese:
「――――――――――」
　そこで、ようやく今の自分の状態を悟った。
　動かない体。
　あげられない声。
　明かりのない暗い洋館。
　……そして、エモノをじっと凝視する誰か。
　これだけお膳立てが揃っていたら、まず殺されてしかるべきだ。
　そこいらのホラー映画なみの状況に、吐き気というより笑いがこみ上げた。
lines.label: s421
lines.maoEnglish:
“…”
Only then did I understand my situation.
A body that wouldn’t move.
A voice that wouldn’t come.
A dark Western-style mansion without a light burning anywhere.
And someone staring fixedly at their prey.
With the stage set so perfectly, being murdered was practically mandatory.
The scene belonged in a cheap horror film, and instead of nausea, laughter welled up inside me.

"----------"
Then I really realize my situation.
I can't move.
I can't even call out.
The dark mansion.
…… That "someone" looks at me as if staring at its prey.
Under all these conditions, it's no surprise if I die here.
This situation seems like such a bad horror movie that I almost start to laugh instead of being scared.

lines.japanese:
「………………は、はは」
　“誰か”は足音一つ立てずにやってくる。
　殺される、という緊迫感のためか、眩暈はさらに加速していく。
「―――――――――」
　気配が止まった。
　“誰か”は倒れた俺を見下ろして、そのまま、無防備な背中に向けて――――
「志貴さん、こんな所で寝てると風邪ひいちゃいますよー」
―――なんて、この上なく陽気なコトバを、投げかけてきた。
lines.label: s421
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ha――――ha, ha”
The figure drew near without making a sound.
Perhaps it was the tension of impending death; the world began spinning faster still.
“…”
The presence stopped.
The figure looked down at me, then turned toward my defenseless back――――
“Shiki, you’ll catch cold if you sleep in a place like this.”
―――and called down to me in the most cheerful voice imaginable.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"……………… Ha, haha."
That "someone" takes a step towards me.
Is it fear of being killed?
My dizziness starts to increase.
"---------"
The presence stops.
It looks down at me and my defenseless back----
"Shiki-san, if you sleep there, you will catch a cold you know."
---and throws me those cheerful words.

lines.japanese:
「………………………琥珀、さん？」
「はい、わたしですけど何ですか？」
　………………どっと力が抜けた。
「志貴さん？
　ホントにどうしたんですか、こんなところで横になって」
　……あくまで陽気な声が聞こえる。
　それで安心してしまったのか、そのまま―――
　眩暈に揺れていた意識は、完全に途絶えてしまった。
lines.label: s421
lines.maoEnglish:
“Kohaku?”
“Yes, it’s me—what is it?”
Every ounce of strength left me at once.
“Shiki? Why are you lying here?”
Her voice remained relentlessly bright.
Perhaps the relief was too much, because then―――
My consciousness, already rocking with vertigo, went out completely.

"Shiki-san?

completely overwhelmed by dizziness, my consciousness shuts down.

lines.japanese:
強い陽射しを感じて目蓋を開けると、そこは自分の部屋だった。
　俺はきちんと寝巻に着替えて、ベッドに横になっている。
「―――――――――そうか、昨日」
　昨日の夜、ロビーで倒れてしまったんだ。
　翡翠は俺に気がつかずに行ってしまって、琥珀さんが物音を聞いてやってきてくれた。
「……ってコトは、出ていったのは秋葉のヤツか」
　……おそらく。
責任感の強い秋葉の事だから、夜の街にシキを捜しに行ったんだろう。
「……あいつ。
シキの事は俺に任せろって言ったのに……」
lines.label: s421
lines.maoEnglish:
When I opened my eyes to strong sunlight, I was in my own room.
I was wearing pajamas and lying in bed.
“That’s right―――――yesterday”
I had collapsed in the foyer.
Hisui had passed me, and Kohaku had come afterward.
“Then Akiha must have been the one who went out.”
Probably. Knowing Akiha’s sense of responsibility, she had gone looking for SHIKI.
“Idiot. I told her to leave SHIKI to me…”

lines.japanese:
「失礼します」
　ノックの音がして、扉が開く。
　やってきたのは洗面器やらタオルやらを持った琥珀さんだった。
「あ、おはようございます志貴さん。
お体の具合はどうですか？」
　いつもと変わらない笑顔で琥珀さんは近寄ってきた。
「―――――――」
　昨夜の翡翠との会話が思い出される。

lines.label: s421
lines.maoEnglish:
“Excuse me.”
A knock sounded, and the door opened.
Kohaku entered carrying a basin, towels, and an assortment of other things.
“Oh, good morning, Shiki. How are you feeling?”
Kohaku approached with her usual smile.
“…”
Last night’s conversation with Hisui came rushing back.
I shoved it into a distant corner of my mind and returned as normal a smile as I could manage.

lines.japanese:
「おはよう琥珀さん。
あの―――昨日の夜、あれから琥珀さんが運んできてくれたんですか？」
「あれ、志貴さん覚えてないんですか？
　志貴さんロビーで横になっていて、お声をかけたら一人で立ちあがって。
いや、よく寝た、とか言って歩き出したんですよー。
肩をお貸ししましたけど、志貴さんはご自分でここまで戻ってきたんです」
「………そう。
なんか、まったく記憶にないんだけど。
ここんところ疲れてるのかな。
自分が何をしていたのか、よく思い出せなくなるんだ」
「はあ。
それじゃ昨夜の事も覚えていないんですか？」
「……多分。
俺の記憶は台所で―――――」
　……翡翠と、琥珀さんの関係を、聞かされたんだ。
lines.label: s421
lines.maoEnglish:
“Morning, Kohaku. Were you the one who brought me here after I collapsed last night?”
“What, don’t you remember, Shiki? You were lying in the foyer when I called to you. You stood up by yourself, said you had slept well, and started walking. I let you lean on me, but you made it back here on your own.”
“I see. I don’t remember any of that. Maybe I’ve been too tired lately. I keep losing track of what I’ve been doing.”
“Oh. Then don’t you remember last night either?”
“Probably not. My memory stops in the kitchen, when―――――”
That was when Hisui told me the truth about herself and Kohaku.

Um---did you carry me up here after last night?"
"Huh?
Do you not remember, Shiki-san?
I found you collapsed in the lobby and you stood up once I called you.

I must have been so tired that I forgot what I did."

"…… Maybe.
I remember being in the kitchen-----"

「あはは、それは残念ですねー。
志貴さん、ずっとわたしに謝っていたんですよ。

「いや。

lines.label: s421
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ahaha, what a shame, Shiki. You spent the whole time apologizing to me.
I kept asking what you were sorry for, but all you would say was that you were an idiot and a blockhead.
Shiki, are you really a blockhead?”
“No. I’m fairly sure I’m human.”
Although at this rate, I did expect people to start throwing stones at me for being a hopelessly insensitive good-for-nothing.
“Anyway, thank you. If I’d slept in the foyer all night, I’d have caught a cold, and school―――”
Wait. Unless my eyes deceived me, the clock was well past ten.

　……それでも構わないと言ってくれた秋葉。
　……翡翠と琥珀さん。
　……そして、いまだ野放しになっている殺人鬼。

琥珀さんに尋ねた所、今朝のニュースで新しい死者が出た、というものはなかったそうだ。
　それでもシキが野放しになっている以上、犠牲者はまた出てきてしまうだろう。
「……この体がもう少し思い通りになってくれれば、俺が―――」

　あんな夢を見続けた影響だろうか。

lines.label: s421
lines.maoEnglish:
Kohaku said the morning news had reported no new deaths.
Even so, as long as SHIKI remained at large, there would be more victims.
“If only this body would do what I tell it, I could―――”
I nearly said I would stop SHIKI, then buried my face in the pillow.
Perhaps those dreams had infected me. My thoughts were as dangerous as SHIKI’s.
“Whatever I do, I need to get well first.”
I closed my eyes.
